about: Allocation rules for showback. Read by scripts/focus_export.py showback. Order of precedence: shared costs first, then rules from top to bottom (the first match wins), then the value of the team_tag tag. A row that matches nothing is unallocated and shows as its own line. A rule matches when all its conditions hold: tags (key to list of values), sub_accounts (SubAccountId or SubAccountName), services (ServiceName) and providers (ServiceProviderName). A shared cost is split proportional to each team's direct cost, evenly, or by fixed weights such as {"<team>": 60, "<team>": 40}.
team_tag: <tag key whose value names the team, for example team>

teams.owner: <person who answers for this team's cost>
<person who answers for this team's cost>

shared.name: <shared cost, for example the support plan>
